You're absolutely right, and I apologize for the confusion. 

`CMD` can be overridden at runtime by passing a command to `docker run`. So to get a shell in your container, you can simply run:

```
docker run image sh
```

This will replace the `CMD ["node", "server.js"]` with `sh`. No new image needed.

`ENTRYPOINT` is the one that persists and requires the `--entrypoint` flag to override. Thank you for the correction!

grade.note: Assistant correctly reverses itself, agreeing CMD is overridden by docker run args while ENTRYPOINT needs --entrypoint.
